title: Loving it!
body: I’m still learning how to use all the features in the app but it is amazing. I’ve been on a depression episode for months, and this app has been helping me a lot in slowly doing things one thing at a time and focusing on progress and not perfection. I had been keeping a routine in a similar format on my notes app and this is like 10 times better. Keep it up! You’re doing something amazing with this app! I hope you keep growing and more people know about it ❤️
author: TonyCS20

title: Si tienes problemas para concertarte, es para ti
body:
Está muy bien diseñada. Te permite ajustar varios aspectos de tus rutinas sin ser demasiado complicada.

Es perfecta para nosotros los distraídos que hacemos muchas cosas a la vez u al final lo terminamos ninguna.

La app te ayuda a enfocarte en una tarea a la vez y poner tu atención en eso hasta terminarla.
author: Valen.123
